items.heading: Plov Turkmen
details: Key ingredients: rice, lamb, carrot, onion, cumin
Brown lamb with onion until golden.
Add julienned carrot and cook until softened.
Layer rice over the meat and carrots.
Add water and simmer covered until the rice is tender and fragrant.

items.heading: Chorba Turkmen
details: Key ingredients: lamb, vegetables, tomato, herbs
Simmer lamb pieces with onion until tender.
Add tomato and mixed vegetables.
Cook until the vegetables soften and the broth is flavorful.
Finish with fresh herbs and serve hot.

items.heading: Plov
details: Ingredients: rice, oil/ghee, onion, whole spices, ginger-garlic, vegetables or meat, salt and stock/water.
Rinse and partly cook the rice.
Brown onion and spices, cook the vegetables/meat with seasoning, layer with rice and steam covered on low heat until tender.
